text: Take a moment to get comfortable where you are.
Let your eyes close, if that feels right.
Notice the places where your body meets what is holding you.
You can simply notice the breath coming and going.
Bring your attention to your hands.
If it is comfortable, rest one hand lightly over the other.
Let your attention stay with that simple point of contact.
And when your mind wanders, you can return to the feeling of your hands.
You don't have to feel peaceful to rest for a moment.
You can be here as you are.
Begin to notice the surface beneath you again.
If you like, make a small movement with your fingers.
Take your time coming back to the room.
When you are ready, let your eyes open.
Take this bit of quiet with you, if you like.
